guided.policy: frozen candidate adapter cost order; choose four lowest-cost gate-passing unrevealed entries

unguided.policy: frozen anchor_cost output from the same CPU adapter; choose four lowest-cost gate-passing unrevealed entries

data.source: real S3 non-sealed RES-07 DL-Train regression capture

metrics.aggregation: average slate widths within context; contexts within family; equal weight across 16 families

bootstrap.sampling_unit: 16 complete families, equal probability, with replacement

kl.metric: maximum per-slate proposal_kl_to_anchor from pinned CpuAdapter, over all unrevealed proposals

metrics.u4: max utility among four common revealed entries plus arm-selected four; utility=-fitness when gate passes, otherwise -2.0

nonclaims: TRAIN diagnostic only; not independent generalization
no signature, production authentication, or default enablement

outcome_ledger.read_unit: (context_sha256, slate_width, candidate_slot); union of up to four guided and four anchor choices; deduplicate overlap
